item.title: JHS Girls Hockey Win Streak Ended By Legacy/Bismarck
item.description: BISMARCK – Claire Oswald scored twice Friday as Legacy/Bismarck ended the two-game winning streak of Jamestown Blue Jays Girls Hockey 7-1 at the VFW Sports Center. Stella Belzer scored the only goal for Jamestown (2-5-0-1, 2-5-0-0 League).

item.title: Dickinson Takes 2026 Jamestown Travel Meet
item.description: JAMESTOWN – Dickinson bested Jamestown Blue Jays Gymnastics and other teams Saturday to win the Jamestown Travel Meet at Jamestown Gymnastics Club. The Mavericks scored 146.125, with Minot United second at 141.550 and Jamestown third with 137.150.
